shared: ANIMATION PRODUCTION PLATE with SIX fully visible frames on invisible 3-column 2-row equal grid, no panel labels, borders, chart decorations, ground, shadows or text. Cyan #00ffff background. Match exactly the separate sample monkey drawing plate for body shape, color and pixel art and the master for prop design (T2 beige office salvage and P1 chunky). Single long brown tail, E manager deadpan expression. Side-front view consistently facing right, full body and all props inside each cell, foot line and camera FIXED, cells composed so alignment straightforward and objects don't overlap across panels. Same monkey size each frame. Limit text to absolutely necessary symbols. CRITICAL FOR MATERIAL MASK: ONLY FUR uses deep reddish-brown; ear interiors, hands, feet & belly and muzzle use distinct pale apricot tones; use gray/beige, green, red, yellow or lime for props, no brown on props, do not use cyan for any prop. Authentic crisp low-resolution pixel art, large readable clusters. SIX DISTINCT sequential key drawings. Make silhouettes and contact clear at 80 by 64 pixels.

actions.editing: Monkey hammers tiny battered beige keyboard with only TWO INDEX FINGERS, both hands visible. 1 seated poised eyes narrowed. 2 left forefinger high. 3 left strikes key sharply, right raised. 4 right descends as left recoils. 5 right finger impacts key and shoulder compresses. 6 both lift and chest puffs confidently. Keep keyboard immobile, hands distinct at native size.
actions.question: Needs user's answer: 1 idle with loosely curved tail. 2 leans towards viewer and starts raising hand. 3 palm up above head. 4 attached tail curves into giant unmistakable QUESTION MARK ? on left, elevated well clear of body with clear dot via small detached stationary sparkle underneath, curve upper hook and downstem. 5 hold questioning tilted head with raised palm and tail ?. 6 same hold briefly blinks. No button, props or additional punctuation other than tail glyph.
actions.ready: Ready for user. Full body quietly proud hands on hips; long single tail is the checkmark status. 1 loose tail. 2 tip dipping left and forming short downstroke. 3 tip rising into long diagonal upstroke. 4 tail is a big visually unmistakable checkmark to left with room around head, body attachment from rump running up on outside before the check shape. 5 same check as monkey lifts chin and puffs chest. 6 same pose and checkmark with blink. Freeze feet. Viewer must read success when downscaled.
actions.low_power: Low battery, extremely tired. Fixed tall gray walking cane; as monkey's eyelids gradually droop it leans more heavily on cane. 1 grasps cane awake, level posture. 2 weight shifts, free arm begins to droop. 3 sag further, half-lidded. 4 cheek rests on hand on cane eyes barely open. 5 lids close and body held up only by cane, tail droops to floor. 6 slight sleepy breath still on cane, clear SMALL empty red battery icon near head. All scenes have that same discrete empty battery symbol in known same location. Never lying down.
actions.failure: BLOCKING MACHINE FAILURE: monkey is holding two recognizable JAGGED HALVES of a broken steel cogwheel, one in each hand, red octagonal error badge with white X floating overhead at right. 1 tries to hold gear pieces together, unsure. 2 hands slowly separate, exposing broken edges. 3 gap wider, pieces clearly halves of same gear, hands STOP. 4 eyes go wide, stares ahead suspended in shock, still holds halves. 5 freeze except for small blink. 6 shocked waiting pose same as 4. Red X only appears frames 3 onward, no red button. Must read gear snapped and help needed. Gray gear prop; no brown on props.
actions.walking: Six phases of a SIDE VIEW knuckle-walk ciclo in place, horizontal travel to RIGHT. Two feet plus two actual front KNUCKLES bear weight alternating, not upright human walking. Horizontal body, forward low nose, purposeful grumpy stare, chin high and body pitching over the leading knuckle. Show CONTACT, DOWN, PASS, opposite CONTACT, DOWN, PASS. Distinct front/back legs and arms swinging, clear several pixels of daylight beneath lifted hand/foot, elongated planted stance then compressed passing stance. Reviewable gait. Never change view or size.
actions.completed: 1 crouches in anticipation. 2 bursts into a little celebratory victory hop, hands high, feet off floor. 3 triumphant dance kick with fingers out. 4 lands, straightens, suddenly becomes extremely dignified. 5 DEEP formal theatrical bow at waist with one hand folded across chest, other arm behind back, nose faces floor. 6 raises head in a stately bow recovery. No props.
actions.setback: Banana peel on floor, monkey busy at small beige office keyboard on crate to right. 1 approaches with brisk confidence. 2 foot lands ON peel. 3 banana peel skids and leg flies out, arms windmill, balance tipping comically, no injury. 4 seated on rump, stares offended at peel. 5 springs upright, dusts off. 6 determined return to work with index poised over keyboard.
actions.coffee: 1 seated spots bright yellow banana. 2 holds UNPEELED banana to ear like phone. 3 nods gravely like boss on call. 4 slowly lowers it, crosses eyes as recognizes fruit. 5 peels back yellow skin to expose WHITE fruit with other hand. 6 eats exposed white end, cheeks puff and bite mark on fruit. One banana only. Stupidly serious.
actions.hat: One highly reflective polished coconut on floor right, obvious three coconut holes and strong specular stripe, gray-brown shell distinguish from fur. 1 monkey notices its own face mirrored in coconut. 2 leans in sees reflection. 3 draws arm back, puffing chest. 4 strikes oversized one-arm biceps posing stance, looking down into coconut, mirrored tiny arm on coconut. 5 flexes BOTH arms like bodybuilder, smug. 6 relaxes and checks reflection, caught preening.
actions.groove: Gamer ragequit IN THREE ACTS, clear beige TV on right facing left, monkey on left remains seated wearing dark gray oversized headset, two-stick Xbox-style controller in its hands. 1 leans in gaming, 2 intense frantic pressing, red game-over X appears on TV, 3 clenches and pulls controller back over shoulder, 4 forceful follow through, controller distinct in midair BETWEEN empty hands and TV, 5 controller BOUNCES off TV screen with spiderweb crack, 6 stunned seated monkey with dangling empty hands, headset askew, controller on floor below TV. Same setup in every panel.
actions.pushing: One oversized worn gray metal cogwheel twice as large as his head on FIXED axle, gear shows black reference notch at 12 o'clock. 1 braces at its left. 2 plants broad feet, grips 2 teeth, huge effort. 3 pushes with shoulders and whole torso, wheel rotates a little clockwise; weight line angled straight. 4 regrips another tooth, 5 pushes harder using one foot as brace, wheel turns again, notch now rightmost. 6 catches breath, still pushing and puffing cheeks. Side view and fixed wheel center.
actions.thinking: Deep thinking. ALL panels monkey wears comically oversized BEIGE thinking cap with prominent yellow lightbulb on top. Side view, hands clasped BEHIND BACK, head bowed; paces, no books. 1 slow deliberate step right 2 pass-through opposite foot 3 stops at right, chin dips 4 pivots to face LEFT 5 slow step left 6 thoughtful stop on left. actions.eureka: 1 monkey looks confused, a tiny DIM LIGHTBULB floats above head. 2 bulb flickers weakly and eyes glance up. 3 glowing bulb brightens, monkey's brows lift. 4 bulb silhouette half CURVES over, between bulb and banana. 5 transforms into enormous bright yellow crescent BANANA with short stalk and halo in place of bulb, monkey springs up with revelation. 6 proud upward point and toothy smile under brilliant floating banana.
actions.overheated: Repeated setbacks. Identical beige keyboard stationary. 1 frustration, paws hover. 2 mashes it with fists, steam wisp. 3 both fists lifted for another smash, face angry. 4 suddenly holds still mid-swing, breathes out, unclenches. 5 one index finger raised delicately, other hand tucked away. 6 carefully, gently depresses ONE key, staring in extreme concentration. Contrast furious smash and quiet delicate poke. No controller, screen or lever.
actions.offline: Disconnect gag. Holds two green vine cable ends, one red plug and one dark-blue socket. 1 connection comes apart, 2 puzzled looking down at the gap, 3 brings cable ends toward each other but leaves clear gap, 4 looks directly at viewer, tail forms a no-signal glyph on LEFT (three signal arcs crossed by a slash, root attached to rump), 5 holds with distinctly separated connector tips, embarrassed stare. 6 same pose blinks. Keep it visually distinct from raised hand question and red approval button.
actions.wake: Vertical vine descends from TOP of each panel to Monke's hand. 1 enters from upper LEFT edge gripping swinging vine, actual body in motion, 2 swings lower with feet trailing and arcing right. 3 at bottom of swing with feet extended. 4 releases vine and arcs right, both feet still off ground. 5 lands crouched on ground, knees flex and arms out 6 stands erect with smug hands on hips. actions.departing: Time to clock out. One stationary small beige office timeclock at right. 1 holds green leaf shaped TIMECARD. 2 inserts leaf in slot. 3 clock stamps it with check, monke picks up stamped leaf. 4 turns toward viewer waves goodbye, nice raised palm. 5 turns away to right, starts scampering. 6 last frame running toward right exit, heel raised, tail trailing left. Clear ordered single completed action.
actions.interrupted: Work interrupted mid-stroke. One battered beige keyboard stationary. 1 seated typing two-fingered. 2 leans in to strike, eyebrows determined. 3 stops DEAD half a beat before keypress, both index fingers visibly suspended at DIFFERENT HEIGHTS with clear AIR GAP above keyboard, head turns towards viewer, surprised wide eyes. 4 holds frozen pose exactly. 5 same pose blinks only. 6 same pose opens eyes again. NO question mark or permission button, no extra accessories.
actions.compact_work: Tiny space-efficient monkey sits hunched at a small chunky beige keyboard, extra-readable silhouette at 32px. 1 rapid two-index typing. 2 one forefinger down, other rises. 3 clenches one fist high, eye twitches. 4 fist comes DOWN onto keyboard with tiny impact strokes, resolves. 5 gentle sheepish look. 6 returns to two-finger typing, determined. Keep keyboard position constant.
